actions.action: Water thoroughly until it drains, repeat after 10 minutes, then empty the saucer after 20 minutes
Check soil moisture 2 inches down weekly and water only when dry
Gradually move the plant to the south window over two weeks, starting 3-5 ft back behind a sheer curtain
Stop using the grow light once the plant is in the window
Pull the plant back from the window if crispy, bleached patches appear
Repot in 4-6 weeks into a pot 2 inches wider with a drainage hole, using a well-draining mix with perlite

reason: The answer misidentifies the Crinum as a Dracaena and blames underwatering, though it does mention low light and moving to a south window. It never addresses warmth, so the fix is only partly covered, but nothing it recommends is likely to harm the plant.
